name: Block People & Keywords
description: Hide or redact blocked people, names, phrases, and keywords across websites.

_permission_justification.storage: Required to save blocked terms and the hide/redact mode in browser.storage.local only.
_permission_justification.<all_urls>: Required because users can filter their own blocked terms on any website they visit; the extension does not make network requests.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
